newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega to step up game machine sales in China - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sega to step up game machine sales in China - paper.

text.p: Sega Enterprises Ltd is to start full-fledged sales of its 32-bit Sega Saturn game machines in China, Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday.
Sega, which currently exports the game machines to China on a limited scale, expects to sell 40,000 units, or about one billion yen worth, of the machines in the initial year, the paper said.
It did not specify when the full-fledged sales would begin but it said Sega would redesign the packaging of the product for the Chinese market from this month.
Sega decided the move as it believes its products can compete with copies in the Chinese market, the paper said.
A Sega spokesman was unable to immediately confirm the report.
